seo.title: Contact DOM VIRUS: bugs, press and security
seo.description: Reach DOM VIRUS through GitHub: issues for bugs and ideas, private reports for security, and the press kit for media. Email coming soon.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: The quickest way to reach DOM VIRUS is GitHub. Report bugs and share ideas in the issues, send security reports privately, and find facts and logos in the press kit. An email address is coming soon.

items.title: Bugs and ideas
items.body: Open an issue on the hub repository. Tell us the page, what happened and your browser. Issues are public.

items.title: Security
items.body: Found a vulnerability? Report it privately through GitHub, never in a public issue.

items.title: Press
items.body: Facts, the roster, logos and the credit line live in the press kit.

items.title: Support the project
items.body: Ways to help today, and sponsorship links once they are live.

items.title: Email
items.body: Coming soon. This page will list the address as soon as it exists.

sections.heading: A bug in one game?

items.title: Fizlet
items.body: The small engine under the games.

sections.subhead: Each game has its own repository. An issue there reaches the same person.

items.question: Is there a contact form?
items.answer: Not yet. A form needs a server, and the site is static for now. Until then, GitHub issues reach us fastest.

items.question: Do I need a GitHub account?
items.answer: Yes, to open an issue or send a security report. A GitHub account is free.

items.question: Where do I report a security problem?
items.answer: Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting on the DOM VIRUS repository. Only the maintainer can read it, so please keep it out of public issues.

items.question: When will there be an email address?
items.answer: Soon. It will appear on this page and in the press kit as soon as it is set up.
